item.title: Self-Hosted Database Schema Documentation 2026: SchemaSpy vs DBeaver ERD vs SchemaCrawler
item.description: Database schema documentation is critical for team collaboration, onboarding, and maintaining data governance. When databases grow to hundreds of tables with complex relationships, having up-to-date, auto-generated documentation becomes essential. This guide compares three open-source tools for self-hosted database schema documentation: SchemaSpy, DBeaver ER Diagrams, and SchemaCrawler.
